# version-kit v4.0.6 (unreleased)

This candidate refreshes indirect requirements used by the optional Fiber
adapter. It contains no library source changes.

| Module | Previous | Candidate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `github.com/gofiber/schema` | v1.9.3 | v1.10.0 |
| `github.com/gofiber/utils/v2` | v2.6.4 | v2.6.5 |
| `github.com/klauspost/compress` | v1.20.3 | v1.20.5 |
| `github.com/valyala/fasthttp` | v1.78.0 | v1.80.0 |
| `golang.org/x/crypto` | v0.58.0 | v0.59.0 |
| `golang.org/x/net` | v0.62.0 | v0.63.0 |
| `golang.org/x/sys` | v0.49.0 | v0.50.0 |
| `golang.org/x/text` | v0.43.0 | v0.44.0 |

Fiber remains v3.7.0 and the Go requirement remains 1.27.4. The module and
`-ldflags -X` symbol paths remain `github.com/soulteary/version-kit/v4`.

After publication:

```sh
go get github.com/soulteary/version-kit/v4@v4.0.6
```

For rollback, restore the application's previous `go.mod` and `go.sum`, then
rebuild. Downgrading version-kit alone may leave newer adapter dependencies
selected in the application.
